title: Grading
body: How BYOB is scored is still being finalised by the program team. What is confirmed: your BYOB scores can affect up to 20% of your CGPA, and missing a milestone deadline carries penalties.
pointer: Full detail comes at the credit and grading session during orientation.

title: Incentives & awards
body: The full incentives and awards structure is still being finalised. What is confirmed: top-performing teams get featured by Mesa, unlock exclusive experiences, present to startup leaders at the end of BYOB, and can win awards across categories aligned to milestones.
pointer: See “What you'll gain” for what's already confirmed.
